title: The Next African Giant
summary:
A bright future for oil production and exports from Namibia
Africa has always been a prolific source of new oil discoveries. In West Africa, countries like Nigeria and Angola have been a mainstay of the international oil markets for decades. Others, like The Republic of the Congo, Ghana, Gabon, and Equatorial Guinea, are more recent additions to the energy landscape.
